window_reset: 00:00 local; uncertain charges remain reserved in their original window, never cleared by reset
units: integer paise, ROUND_CEILING per reservation; rate version + invoice currency + planning FX/tax margin

app.admission: Atomic row-lock transaction reserves user/component/day/build/evaluation buckets together. Each dispatch/retry attempt has unique idempotency key and its own reservation. Unknown price, unavailable ledger, ASLEEP, exhausted bucket or unknown unsupported fee -> deny.
app.settlement: Settle once from provider billable usage, release only verified unused amount. Timeout/crash/expired lease remains UNCERTAIN and covered; late billing reconciles original window; actual above bound freezes further calls.

native_genie.callers: Actual benchmark/app service principal and human caller identities recorded; free human use/promotions excluded from estimate.
native_genie.control: Not covered by application ledger. Restrict ACLs/access outside funded windows. Shared threshold is approximate, not invoice cap. Pilot and approximate-block test before benchmark; count all native tool calls.

probes.principal: Isolated temporary probe principal; no business users or unbounded tools
probes.rule: Proposed INR2000 envelope includes all Phase2 meters/tails and preflight200. Pending budget decision; not additional funding. Each cost remains in global build model.
probes.cleanup: Revoke temporary grants, delete fixtures through owners, keep uncertain charges/tails reserved

controller.authoritative_state: ADLS control object + resource/session manifest with ETag/lease compare-and-swap; hc_ops mirror only while awake
controller.guard: Daily external control-plane inspection, no data query/job/notebook; independent hard-deadline shutdown

ledger: Both subscriptions plus retained prerequisites; gross consumption, credits and net separate. Join usage to time-valid SKU list prices, handle retractions/restatements and deduplicate record IDs; Azure-billed Databricks usage not counted twice. UNKNOWN/PENDING is not zero.
